questions.stem: A 45-year-old male presents to the emergency department with severe weakness and palpitations. He has been on a thiazide diuretic for hypertension. His ECG reveals flattened T waves and the presence of U waves. Serum potassium is 2.3 mEq/L. What is the most appropriate initial treatment for this patient?

options.label: B
options.text: IV potassium chloride 10 mEq/hour with cardiac monitoring

options.label: C
options.text: IV potassium chloride 20 mEq/hour with cardiac monitoring

options.label: D
options.text: IV potassium chloride 25 mEq/hour with cardiac monitoring
